about.en: Software engineer with nearly 14 years of experience, eight of them building single-page applications in TypeScript, first with Angular and then with React. I am comfortable across the stack, with .NET, Node.js and SQL behind the front end and React Native on mobile, and I work with AI-assisted development daily. I like to own a piece of work end to end: understand the need, build it properly, and stay responsible for it afterwards. I am at my best in a small team that skips the fluff and gets things done.
about.sl: Višji razvijalec programske opreme s skoraj 14 leti izkušenj, od tega 8 let frontend razvoja, večinoma SPA aplikacij v TypeScriptu (Angular od leta 2018, React od leta 2021). Full-stack izkušnje: .NET, Node.js in SQL na backendu, React Native za mobilne aplikacije. Pri razvoju vsak dan uporabljam AI orodja. Naloge prevzemam v celoti, od zahtev do produkcije in vzdrževanja. Najraje delam v manjših ekipah.
